facts.name: Bill row count and total
facts.described_as: Count, or total the quantity or amount of, the bill of quantities rows whose description contains every given term (optionally only inside a section). Use this for 'how many items ...' and 'what is the total quantity / amount of ...' over a bill: it reads every row of the bill and lists the rows it used with reference and page. Report its count, sum and rows as given; do not add figures yourself.

inputs.name: terms
inputs.label: description words
inputs.described_as: Words every matching row's description contains.

inputs.name: section
inputs.label: section words
inputs.described_as: Words of the bill section (heading path) to stay inside. Optional.

inputs.name: document_id
inputs.label: document id
inputs.described_as: The bill document (source PDF or its derived sheet). Optional: default every derived bill.

hints.purpose: Counts and totals the bill rows matching the words given. One call reads every row of each derived bill sheet (or only the one of document_id) and returns per bill the count, the sum (one sum per unit when units differ), each row used with reference and page where the sheet gives them, and the rows without a figure. Bills are never added together. The same call again returns the same rows.

not_to_be_confused_with.difference: A search returns a few ranked passages; this tool reads every row of the bill, so only it can give a complete count or total.
That one returns a bill's section headings; this one counts and totals the rows.

question_kinds.how: A question answered by one passage needs no count or total; search instead.
Pass the words of the item, and the section when the question names one; report its count, sum and rows as given, without adding figures.
Gives the bill side when the question needs a total or count of the items the specification clause governs; the clause itself comes from a search.
It reads only bill rows; neither a specification clause nor a drawing is a bill row.
